# Faith Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** eleven  <sub>[v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c15 P36](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0036)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Red Rose  <sub>[v5 c16 P65](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0065)</sub>

## Appearance

Faith is described as being as pretty as a picture, wearing her beauty like a rose. She has golden-brown eyes, golden-brown curls, and crimson cheeks.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 c4 P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006)_

## Personality

Faith possesses a joyous, original, and spirited nature, declaring that the world is one of laughter rather than a vale of tears. She is a energetic tomboy who is dramatic, proud, heedless, and impulsive. Her tempers are short-lived, and she is filled with full of spunk and vim, inspiring those around her.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 c2 P31](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0031), [v5 c4 P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006), [v5 c5 P72](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0072), [v5 c5 P85](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0085), [v5 c16 P60](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0060), [v5 c23 P56](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0056), [v5 c24 P11](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0011), [v5 c26 P19](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0019), [v5 c26 P22](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0022)_

- refuses to ever marry a minister  <sub>[v5 c15 P37](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0037)</sub>
- wants to convince Norman Douglas to return to church  <sub>[v5 c15 P38](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0038)</sub>

## History

Faith grew up in Maywater before her family relocated to the manse in Glen St. Mary. Soon after arriving, she befriended the Ingleside children, forming a strong bond over a shared meal and setting up regular gatherings in Rainbow Valley. She frequently fell into scrapes due to her heedless nature, including accidentally dropping a pail of milk and eggs down the cellar and getting confused about days of the week, which led to her cleaning house on Sunday. When her pet rooster Adam was carved and served for supper by the visiting Rev. James Perry, Faith was deeply upset and detested the minister. In an attempt to solve the minister's salary issue, Faith impulsively visited Norman Douglas and convinced him to return to church, earning his respect and the nickname 'Red Rose'. Later, she helped form the Good-Conduct Club with her siblings to self-enforce discipline, though she suffered through punishments like eating soggy bread after mistaking a white object in the old Bailey garden for Henry Warren's ghost.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P30](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0030), [v5 c4 P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c12 P6](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0006), [v5 c15 P38](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0038), [v5 c16 P60](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0060), [v5 c16 P65](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0065), [v5 c19 P7](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0007), [v5 c23 P56](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0056), [v5 c23 P79](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0079), [v5 c30 P0](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0000), [v5 c30 P3](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0003), [v5 c31 P12](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0012)_
